notes: Manifest identity: the login gate carries data-manifest=manifest-56f69135b336b68262f4.json; during the initial unlock and the refresh unlock the page requested that exact manifest with HTTP 200, and the served manifest SHA-256 equals the preview file. The access script is removed after mount, so the mounted DOM no longer has script[data-manifest]; identity is evidenced by the gate attribute, the two runtime manifest GETs and the served hash.

Replay network semantics: the /api/chat response event is the Playwright route fulfillment on the same-origin URL, not an upstream backend response. Exactly one chat request was intercepted and fulfilled from the recorded response; no chat request reached 127.0.0.1:8792 and no generation call was made. The 2 /api/session and 3 /api/status calls are real read-only auth/status calls to the P1 backend.

Dialog accent: the corresponding accent is applied as the 2px left border and kicker of the dialog title (amber for the source dialog, violet for the process dialog). The outer dialog frame border remains the neutral --as-border rgba(158, 181, 209, 0.14) by design; it is not intended to be an amber/violet frame.
The fixture replay reproduces the real answer content and 3/3 citation semantics, but it is not a new model call. The preview backend was alive and answered /api/session and /api/status.
